answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 145 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is entered against the vault challenge, the shale audit can replay the walnut history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1560 identities would post 1440 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
